miscellaneous.question: Miscellaneous
miscellaneous.answer: The hexes of Hamburg and Harburg may be upgraded only by the HAV. There are special bonuses (see rule 6.2.4) for connecting hexes F18, and O13. Rule 6.2.2 'Restrictions for Coastal Towns' describes restrictions on upgrades of all towns, not just coastal ones. If a player holds at least two shares in each of at least three companies, their certificate limit is increased by one. This increase may be anticipated in buying the second share in a company. There are hexes on the board which are yellow but have no track. These may not be developed until the green phase, and the first tiles laid on them must be yellow. At least one of a set of routes must include the company's starting place. Some tiles bear two values for the stations. The higher values are used if the company has a station marker on the tile.
